answer_text: I believe this argument is based on the fact that intelligence is a single dimension when it really isn't. Are machines and humans really on the same level if a machine can solve a complex problem in a millionth of the time a human can? It also assumes that the Turing machine is still the best computational model for the time period that you are in, which is not necessarily true for the future, it is just true until this point in time.
